class_example: yān'īdha bhūtāni samāgatāni, bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe. sabb'eva bhūtā sumanā bhavantu, atho'pi sakkacca suṇantu bhāsitaṃ.
english_translation: Whichever living beings gathered here, earthly or in the sky: may all living beings be happy and then let them respectfully listen to what is said ([this] utterance).

class_example: khayaṃ virāgaṃ amataṃ paṇītaṃ, yad'ajjhagā sakyamunī samāhito. na tena dhammena sam’atthi kiñci
english_translation: Wearing away, dispassion, the superior deathless state – whatever the Sakyan sage, concentrated, obtained; there is not anything equal to that doctrine.
